intro: Instinct nailed one thing: handing off an errand by text or call. You reach it over WhatsApp, iMessage, or email, and it works across your connected apps and devices. GAIA respects that habit and meets you in WhatsApp and Telegram too. The difference is control. GAIA is source-available and self-hostable, with deep integrations and memory that spans all your tools, so the errand connects to the rest of your work in a system you can inspect.
